body: Operator report: the on-call got paged three times last week while latency was low and healthy, and got NO page during the real latency incident. app/alerts.py should_page(metric, value, threshold) is supposed to page when the value rises ABOVE the threshold (that is what describe_rule() says), but the comparison is inverted. Fix should_page() so it pages exactly when value > threshold; at or below the threshold it must not page. Acceptance: should_page('latency_ms', 900, 500) is True; should_page('latency_ms', 100, 500) is False; should_page('latency_ms', 500, 500) stays False; existing tests still pass.
title: Alert threshold comparison is inverted — pages on healthy values, silent in incidents
